review_comments.body: Why these three classes? No other command sorts errors this way. Cannot we just catch the known failures where they happen, like `getRedocOptions` does, and drop this `catch`, so the wrapper prints the rest with the stack?
This test has more mocks than the actual testing. Is there a description that reproduces the `TypeError`? Then it could be an e2e test in `tests/e2e/build-docs`.
